name: kinetic-ui-ux-pro
description: Kinetic UI UX Pro is an installable UI/UX engineering skill for framing, building, auditing, and verifying accessible, state-complete, token-conformant product interfaces.

scripts.description: Tree-sitter structural UI audit with SARIF/JUnit output, design-token drift, project graph checks, breakpoint analysis, and static geometry heuristics.
OKLCH/sRGB conversion, gamut mapping, WCAG contrast, APCA Lc, and ramp utilities.
Fetches third-party registry component source into a temp directory, remaps hardcoded design values to verified tokens, injects adapter conformance patches, and verifies the adapted output.
Builds a searchable design-system corpus from tokens, Tailwind/theme CSS, CSS custom properties, and TSX component manifests.
BM25 design-token and registry component search, hardcoded value matching, OKLab color comparison, and drift reports.
Recommends a compatible style, palette, and industry pack from a brief, with tradeoffs and optional verified token generation.
Safely writes or emits shell commands from a JSON file manifest for CLI-agent environments.
Computes real font metric override values such as size-adjust and ascent-override.
Prints industry-specific rule checklists and runs conservative heuristics for detectable domain rules.
Conservative license gate for dependencies, vendored source, and third-party attribution notices.
Searches 208 verified mood-organized palette seeds, previews ramps, imports Radix reference seeds, pairs compatible styles, and verifies all palettes with token_gen.py.
Syncs metadata-only component registry catalogs into .registry/components.jsonl with adapter license gates and sanitized ETag caching.
Applies visual style constraints plus repeatable modifiers to a brand hue, validates compatibility, retries inside constraints, and emits only verified token schemas.
Deterministic token generation, Style Dictionary and Radix Colors interop, and dual WCAG/APCA contrast verification.
Regex fallback UI audit when tree-sitter dependencies are unavailable.
